# Engine SQL function reference

<!-- Generated by python3 scripts/generate-sql-udf-reference.py; do not edit directly. -->

Every Streamling SQL session starts with DataFusion's built-in functions and then registers,
in order (`crates/streamling-core/src/session.rs`):

1. [Flink-compatible JSON functions](#flink-compatible-json-functions) and [aggregates](#flink-compatible-json-aggregates) (`register_json_functions`).
2. [Flink-compatible string functions](#flink-compatible-string-functions) and [aliases of DataFusion built-ins](#flink-compatible-aliases-of-datafusion-built-ins) (`register_string_aliases`).
3. [Streamling functions](#streamling-functions) (`CommonFunctions::functions()`) and [session functions](#session-functions) (`StreamlingFunctions::functions()`).
4. Plugin-provided functions, which depend on which plugins a deployment loads and are not listed here.

A later registration replaces an earlier function with the same name, so several functions below
replace DataFusion built-ins; their entries say so. Unquoted SQL function names are lowercased
before lookup, so `SPLIT_INDEX(...)` calls `split_index`. These mixed-case registrations are
omitted below, because an unquoted call resolves to its lowercase spelling instead: `CHAR_LENGTH`, `DATE_FORMAT`, `dateFormat`, `regexpCount`, `regexpExtract`, `regexpExtractAll`, `regexpInstr`, `regexpReplace`, `regexpSubstr`.

Names beginning with `_gs_` are internal-style names but are registered under exactly those names.

The **accepted types** column reflects the Rust DataFusion signature, narrowed by
runtime checks where necessary. `Any` in a DataFusion signature means the planner
accepts any type, *not* that the implementation can process all types. The runtime
constraints below each function narrow that signature. `String` and *string* mean
Utf8, LargeUtf8 or Utf8View. `U256` and `I256` are tagged
`FixedSizeBinary(32)` values (big-endian), normally produced by `to_u256` and `to_i256`.

### `now`

**Signature:** `now()` → `Timestamp(Nanosecond, UTC)`. **DataFusion signature:** `()`.

Current UTC timestamp, evaluated per batch; alias: `current_timestamp`.

```sql
SELECT now();
```

Source: [`now.rs`](../crates/streamling-common/src/functions/now.rs) (`VolatileNowFunc`).

<a id="udf-gs-json-objects-to-clickhouse-tuples"></a>

### `_gs_json_objects_to_clickhouse_tuples`

**Signature:** `_gs_json_objects_to_clickhouse_tuples(json, keys)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Utf8, List<Utf8> (non-null items))`.

**Rust doc summary:** Converts a JSON array of objects into ClickHouse-compatible tuple format.

Format selected keys from a JSON object array as ClickHouse tuples; keys are taken from the first list and must be a `List<Utf8>` with a non-nullable item field.

```sql
SELECT _gs_json_objects_to_clickhouse_tuples('[{"pubkey":"abc"}]', ARRAY['pubkey']);
```

Source: [`json_objects_to_clickhouse_tuples.rs`](../crates/streamling-common/src/functions/json_objects_to_clickhouse_tuples.rs) (`JsonObjectsToClickhouseTuplesFunc`).

<a id="udf-gs-split-string-to-array"></a>

### `_gs_split_string_to_array`

**Signature:** `_gs_split_string_to_array(text[, separator])` → `List<Utf8>`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Utf8) or (Utf8, Utf8)`.

**Rust doc summary:** Splits a string into an array of substrings based on a separator.

Split text on separator (space by default). Literal arguments are read as one-row arrays, so mixing literal and column arguments fails on batches of more than one row. To split a column, omit the separator (spaces) or use DataFusion's `string_to_array`.

```sql
SELECT _gs_split_string_to_array('a-b', '-');
```

Source: [`split_string_to_array.rs`](../crates/streamling-common/src/functions/split_string_to_array.rs) (`SplitStringToArrayFunc`).

<a id="udf-gs-generate-series"></a>

### `_gs_generate_series`

**Signature:** `_gs_generate_series(start, stop[, step])` → `List<Int64>`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Int64, Int64) or (Int64, Int64, Int64)`.

**Rust doc summary:** Generates a series of numbers from start to stop with an optional step.

Inclusive integer series; step defaults to 1 and must not be zero, and a negative step counts down. Literal arguments are read as one-row arrays, so mixing literal and column arguments fails on batches of more than one row. For a literal start with a column stop, use DataFusion's built-in `generate_series`.

```sql
SELECT _gs_generate_series(1, 5, 2);
```

Source: [`generate_series.rs`](../crates/streamling-common/src/functions/generate_series.rs) (`GenerateSeriesFunc`).

<a id="udf-gs-zip-arrays"></a>

### `_gs_zip_arrays`

**Signature:** `_gs_zip_arrays(array1, array2[, array3[, array4]])` → `List<Struct<f0: T0, f1: T1, ...>>`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, ...)`.

**Rust doc summary:** Zips multiple arrays into an array of structs (rows).

Requires 2–4 `List` inputs; each row's lists must have equal length. Struct fields are named f0, f1, etc.

```sql
SELECT _gs_zip_arrays(ARRAY[1, 2], ARRAY['a', 'b']);
```

Source: [`zip_arrays.rs`](../crates/streamling-common/src/functions/zip_arrays.rs) (`ZipArraysFunc`).

<a id="udf-array-enumerate"></a>

### `array_enumerate`

**Signature:** `array_enumerate(list)` → `List<Struct<index: Int64, value: T>>`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any)`.

**Rust doc summary:** The `array_enumerate` function pairs each element in an array with its 0-based index.

Requires `List<T>` (not LargeList); pairs each value with its zero-based index.

```sql
SELECT array_enumerate(ARRAY['a', 'b']);
```

Source: [`array_enumerate.rs`](../crates/streamling-common/src/functions/array_enumerate.rs) (`ArrayEnumerateFunc`).

<a id="udf-array-filter"></a>

### `array_filter`

**Signature:** `array_filter(list, field_name, value)` → `List<Struct<...>>`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, Any, Any)`.

Requires `List<Struct>` and non-null `Utf8` field name (literal or column). Named field and value must have matching types: Utf8, Boolean, Int8/16/32/64, UInt8/16/32/64, Float32/64, or a NULL value. Returns matching elements.

```sql
SELECT array_filter(changes, 'kind', 'transfer') FROM events;
```

Source: [`array_filter.rs`](../crates/streamling-common/src/functions/array_filter.rs) (`ArrayFilterFunc`).

<a id="udf-array-filter-first"></a>

### `array_filter_first`

**Signature:** `array_filter_first(list, field_name, value)` → `Struct<...> or NULL`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, Any, Any)`.

Same type rules as `array_filter`; returns the first matching struct, or NULL.

```sql
SELECT array_filter_first(changes, 'kind', 'transfer') FROM events;
```

Source: [`array_filter_first.rs`](../crates/streamling-common/src/functions/array_filter_first.rs) (`ArrayFilterFirstFunc`).

<a id="udf-array-filter-in"></a>

### `array_filter_in`

**Signature:** `array_filter_in(list, field_name, values)` → `List<Struct<...>>`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, Any, Any)`.

Requires `List<Struct>`, non-null `Utf8` field name (literal or column), and a `List<Utf8>` or `List<Int64>` of comparison values (a direct Utf8 array is also accepted). Named field must be Utf8 or Int64 respectively; the first values list is used for all rows.

```sql
SELECT array_filter_in(changes, 'kind', ARRAY['transfer', 'mint']) FROM events;
```

Source: [`array_filter_in.rs`](../crates/streamling-common/src/functions/array_filter_in.rs) (`ArrayFilterInFunc`).

<a id="udf-array-struct-field"></a>

### `array_struct_field`

**Signature:** `array_struct_field(list, field_name)` → `List<Utf8>`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, Any)`.

**Rust doc summary:** Projects one `Utf8` field out of every struct element of a `List<Struct>`, producing a `List<Utf8>` with the same shape (offsets and row nulls are reused zero-copy; only the values array is swapped for the struct's child column). Null struct elements become null strings.

Projects an Utf8 field from `List<Struct>`; field_name **must be a non-null Utf8 string literal**, not a column.

```sql
SELECT array_struct_field(changes, 'kind') FROM events;
```

Source: [`array_struct_field.rs`](../crates/streamling-common/src/functions/array_struct_field.rs) (`ArrayStructFieldFunc`).

<a id="udf-to-large-list"></a>

### `to_large_list`

**Signature:** `to_large_list(list)` → `LargeList<T>`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any)`.

**Rust doc summary:** Converts a List array (i32 offsets) to a LargeList array (i64 offsets).

Accepts List<T>, LargeList<T>, or FixedSizeList<T>; converts offsets to 64-bit (passes through LargeList).

```sql
SELECT to_large_list(items) FROM events;
```

Source: [`to_large_list.rs`](../crates/streamling-common/src/functions/to_large_list.rs) (`ToLargeListFunc`).

<a id="udf-gs-xxhash"></a>

### `_gs_xxhash`

**Signature:** `_gs_xxhash(text)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Utf8)`.

**Rust doc summary:** Provides XXH128 non-cryptographic hashing for strings.

XXH3-128 digest of UTF-8 text as 32 hex characters; non-cryptographic.

```sql
SELECT _gs_xxhash('hello');
```

Source: [`xxhash.rs`](../crates/streamling-common/src/functions/xxhash.rs) (`XxHashFunc`).

<a id="udf-gs-keccak256"></a>

### `_gs_keccak256`

**Signature:** `_gs_keccak256(text)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Utf8)`.

**Rust doc summary:** Provides Keccak256 cryptographic hashing for strings.

Keccak-256 hash as `0x`-prefixed hex; a `0x`-prefixed input is decoded as hex first.

```sql
SELECT _gs_keccak256('hello');
```

Source: [`keccak256.rs`](../crates/streamling-common/src/functions/keccak256.rs) (`Keccak256Func`).

<a id="udf-gs-conv-base"></a>

### `_gs_conv_base`

**Signature:** `_gs_conv_base(number, from_base, to_base)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Utf8, Int32, Int32) or (Utf8, Utf8, Utf8)`.

**Rust doc summary:** Converts numbers between different bases.

Convert an Utf8 number between bases 2–36; an invalid number or a base outside 2–36 returns NULL. Bases are read as Int32 only when `from_base` is an Int32 column; otherwise both bases must be Utf8, so pass literal bases as strings (`'16'`, not `16`). Pass all three arguments as literals or all three as columns: literal bases combined with a `number` column are one-row arrays and fail on batches of more than one row.

```sql
SELECT _gs_conv_base('FF', '16', '10'); -- '255'
```

Source: [`conv_base.rs`](../crates/streamling-common/src/functions/conv_base.rs) (`ConvBaseFunc`).

<a id="udf-coalesce-meta"></a>

### `coalesce_meta`

**Signature:** `coalesce_meta(first[, next, ...])` → `FixedSizeBinary(32)`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, ...)`.

First non-null value per row, preserving the first field's metadata; **runtime supports only identical FixedSizeBinary(32) arguments**, despite the variadic-any planner signature.

```sql
SELECT coalesce_meta(primary_id, fallback_id) FROM events;
```

Source: [`coalesce_meta.rs`](../crates/streamling-common/src/functions/coalesce_meta.rs) (`CoalesceMetaUdf`).

**Signature:** `json_string(value)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any)`.


Source: [`json_string.rs`](../crates/streamling-common/src/functions/json_string.rs) (`JsonStringFunc`).

## Session functions

Registered by `StreamlingFunctions::functions()` in `crates/streamling-core/src/functions.rs`; it needs the session's dynamic table registry.

| Function | Signature | Accepted types | Returns |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`dynamic_table_check`](#udf-dynamic-table-check) | `dynamic_table_check(table_name, value)` | `string table name; string, List<string> or LargeList<string> value (string dictionaries accepted)` | `Boolean` |

<a id="udf-dynamic-table-check"></a>

### `dynamic_table_check`

**Signature:** `dynamic_table_check(table_name, value)` → `Boolean`. **DataFusion signature:** `user-defined`.

True when `value` is in the named dynamic table. `table_name` is a string literal, or a string column whose rows all hold the same name; an unknown name fails at execution. A string `value` that is NULL returns NULL. A `List<Utf8>`/`LargeList<Utf8>` value returns true when any non-null element is in the table; a NULL list returns NULL and an empty list returns false.

```sql
SELECT * FROM transfers WHERE dynamic_table_check('tracked_wallets', from_address);
```

Source: [`dynamic_table.rs`](../crates/streamling-core/src/functions/dynamic_table.rs) (`DynamicTableCheckFunc`).

## Flink-compatible string functions

Registered by `register_string_aliases` in `crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/registry.rs`.
Unless noted, a NULL argument returns NULL, string arguments accept any *string* type and integer arguments accept any integer type.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`regexp_extract`](#udf-regexp-extract) | `regexp_extract(text, pattern[, group])` | `(Utf8, Utf8) or (Utf8, Utf8, Int64)` | `Utf8` |
| [`regexp_extract_all`](#udf-regexp-extract-all) | `regexp_extract_all(text, pattern[, group])` | `(Utf8, Utf8) or (Utf8, Utf8, Int64)` | `List<Utf8>` |
| [`regexp_substr`](#udf-regexp-substr) | `regexp_substr(text, pattern)` | `(Utf8, Utf8); 3- and 4-argument calls fail at execution` | `Utf8` |
| [`regexp_count`](#udf-regexp-count) | `regexp_count(text, pattern)` | `(Utf8, Utf8)` | `Int64` |
| [`regexp_instr`](#udf-regexp-instr) | `regexp_instr(text, pattern[, start[, occurrence]])` | `string, string[, integer[, integer]]` | `Int64` |
| [`regexp_replace`](#udf-regexp-replace) | `regexp_replace(text, pattern, replacement)` | `(Utf8, Utf8, Utf8)` | `Utf8` |
| [`locate`](#udf-locate) | `locate(substring, text[, start])` | `string, string[, integer]` | `Int64` |
| [`instr`](#udf-instr) | `instr(text, substring[, start[, occurrence]])` | `string, string[, integer[, integer]]` | `Int64` |
| [`bin`](#udf-bin) | `bin(integer)` | `one integer` | `Utf8` |
| [`elt`](#udf-elt) | `elt(index, value1[, value2, ...])` | `integer, then one or more values` | `Utf8` |
| [`parse_url`](#udf-parse-url) | `parse_url(url, part[, key])` | `string, string[, string]` | `Utf8` |
| [`split`](#udf-split) | `split(text, delimiter)` | `string, string` | `List<Utf8>` |
| [`split_index`](#udf-split-index) | `split_index(text, delimiter, index)` | `string, string, integer` | `Utf8` |
| [`translate`](#udf-translate) | `translate(text, from, to)` | `string, string, string` | `Utf8` |
| [`unhex`](#udf-unhex) | `unhex(hex)` | `one string` | `Binary` |
| [`url_encode`](#udf-url-encode) | `url_encode(text)` | `one string` | `Utf8` |
| [`url_decode`](#udf-url-decode) | `url_decode(text)` | `one string` | `Utf8` |

<a id="udf-regexp-extract"></a>

### `regexp_extract`

**Signature:** `regexp_extract(text, pattern[, group])` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Utf8, Utf8) or (Utf8, Utf8, Int64)`.

Capture `group` of the first match (0, the default, is the whole match; a NULL `group` uses the default). Invalid pattern, no match, or a negative or out-of-range group returns NULL.

```sql
SELECT regexp_extract('foothebar', 'foo(.*?)(bar)', 2); -- 'bar'
```

Source: [`regex.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/regex.rs) (`RegexpExtractUdf`).

<a id="udf-regexp-extract-all"></a>

### `regexp_extract_all`

**Signature:** `regexp_extract_all(text, pattern[, group])` → `List<Utf8>`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Utf8, Utf8) or (Utf8, Utf8, Int64)`.

Capture `group` (default 1; 0 is the whole match) of every match. No match returns an empty list; an invalid pattern or a negative or out-of-range group returns NULL.

```sql
SELECT regexp_extract_all('100-200, 300-400', '(\d+)-(\d+)', 1); -- ['100', '300']
```

Source: [`regex.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/regex.rs) (`RegexpExtractAllUdf`).

<a id="udf-regexp-substr"></a>

### `regexp_substr`

**Signature:** `regexp_substr(text, pattern)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Utf8, Utf8) or (Utf8, Utf8, Int64) or (Utf8, Utf8, Int64, Int64)`.

First whole match; no match or an invalid pattern returns NULL. The planner also accepts 3- and 4-argument calls, but execution rejects them.

```sql
SELECT regexp_substr('100-200, 300-400', '(\d+)-(\d+)$'); -- '300-400'
```

Source: [`regex.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/regex.rs) (`RegexpSubstrUdf`).

<a id="udf-regexp-count"></a>

### `regexp_count`

**Signature:** `regexp_count(text, pattern)` → `Int64`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Utf8, Utf8)`.

Number of non-overlapping matches; an invalid pattern returns NULL. Replaces DataFusion's built-in `regexp_count`, so its start and flags arguments are not available.

```sql
SELECT regexp_count('a.b.c.d', '\.'); -- 3
```

Source: [`regex.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/regex.rs) (`RegexpCountUdf`).

<a id="udf-regexp-instr"></a>

### `regexp_instr`

**Signature:** `regexp_instr(text, pattern[, start[, occurrence]])` → `Int64`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, ...)`.

1-based position of the `occurrence`-th match (default 1), searching from `start` (default 1). No match returns 0, an invalid pattern returns NULL, and `start` or `occurrence` below 1 is an error. Replaces DataFusion's built-in `regexp_instr`.

```sql
SELECT regexp_instr('hello world! Hello everyone!', 'Hello'); -- 14
```

Source: [`regex.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/regex.rs) (`RegexpInstrUdf`).

<a id="udf-regexp-replace"></a>

### `regexp_replace`

**Signature:** `regexp_replace(text, pattern, replacement)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Utf8, Utf8, Utf8)`.

Replace every match. `replacement` is literal: `$1` / `\1` group references are not expanded. An invalid pattern returns NULL. Replaces DataFusion's built-in `regexp_replace`, so its flags argument is not available.

```sql
SELECT regexp_replace('hello world! Hello everyone!', 'Hello', 'Hi'); -- 'hello world! Hi everyone!'
```

Source: [`regex.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/regex.rs) (`RegexpReplaceUdf`).

<a id="udf-locate"></a>

### `locate`

**Signature:** `locate(substring, text[, start])` → `Int64`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, ...)`.

1-based position of the first `substring` at or after `start` (default 1); not found or `start` below 1 returns 0.

```sql
SELECT locate('bar', 'foobarbar', 5); -- 7
```

Source: [`scalars.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/scalars.rs) (`LocateUdf`).

<a id="udf-instr"></a>

### `instr`

**Signature:** `instr(text, substring[, start[, occurrence]])` → `Int64`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, ...)`.

1-based position of the `occurrence`-th `substring` (default 1). A negative `start` searches backward from the end; `start` 0 or not found returns 0; `occurrence` below 1 returns NULL. Replaces DataFusion's `instr` alias of `strpos` (`strpos` keeps the built-in behavior).

```sql
SELECT instr('foobarbar', 'bar', 1, 2); -- 7
```

Source: [`scalars.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/scalars.rs) (`InstrUdf`).

<a id="udf-bin"></a>

### `bin`

**Signature:** `bin(integer)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, ...)`.

Binary representation of an integer; negative values are prefixed with `-`. Non-integer input is an error.

```sql
SELECT bin(42); -- '101010'
```

Source: [`scalars.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/scalars.rs) (`BinUdf`).

<a id="udf-elt"></a>

### `elt`

**Signature:** `elt(index, value1[, value2, ...])` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, ...)`.

The `index`-th (1-based) value as text; a NULL or out-of-range index returns NULL. Non-string values are converted to text.

```sql
SELECT elt(2, 'foo', 'bar', 'baz'); -- 'bar'
```

Source: [`scalars.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/scalars.rs) (`EltUdf`).

<a id="udf-parse-url"></a>

### `parse_url`

**Signature:** `parse_url(url, part[, key])` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, ...)`.

URL component: `HOST`, `PATH`, `QUERY` (with `key`, that query parameter's value), `REF`, `PROTOCOL`, `FILE`, `AUTHORITY` or `USERINFO` (case-insensitive). An unknown part or unparseable URL returns NULL.

```sql
SELECT parse_url('http://user:pass@example.com/path?query=1#frag', 'QUERY', 'query'); -- '1'
```

Source: [`scalars.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/scalars.rs) (`ParseUrlUdf`).

<a id="udf-split"></a>

### `split`

**Signature:** `split(text, delimiter)` → `List<Utf8>`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, ...)`.

Split on a literal delimiter, keeping empty tokens; an empty delimiter splits into characters. NULL text or delimiter returns NULL.

```sql
SELECT split(',123,,,123,', ','); -- ['', '123', '', '', '123', '']
```

Source: [`scalars.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/scalars.rs) (`SplitUdf`).

<a id="udf-split-index"></a>

### `split_index`

**Signature:** `split_index(text, delimiter, index)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, Any, Any)`.

The `index`-th (0-based) token after splitting on a literal delimiter; a negative or out-of-range index returns NULL. An empty delimiter leaves the text as a single token.

```sql
SELECT split_index(topics, ',', 0) AS event_signature FROM logs;
```

Source: [`scalars.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/scalars.rs) (`SplitIndexUdf`).

<a id="udf-translate"></a>

### `translate`

**Signature:** `translate(text, from, to)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, ...)`.

Also callable as `translate3`.

Replace each character of `from` with the character at the same position in `to`; `from` characters with no counterpart are removed, and the first occurrence of a repeated `from` character wins. NULL `from` returns `text` unchanged; NULL `to` removes every `from` character. Replaces DataFusion's built-in `translate`.

```sql
SELECT translate('cat', 'at', 'o'); -- 'co'
```

Source: [`scalars.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/scalars.rs) (`TranslateUdf`).

<a id="udf-unhex"></a>

### `unhex`

**Signature:** `unhex(hex)` → `Binary`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, ...)`.

Decode hex text; odd-length input is left-padded with a 0 nibble and any non-hex character returns NULL.

```sql
SELECT unhex('466C696E6B'); -- bytes of 'Flink'
```

Source: [`scalars.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/scalars.rs) (`UnhexUdf`).

<a id="udf-url-encode"></a>

### `url_encode`

**Signature:** `url_encode(text)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, ...)`.

Form URL encoding: space becomes `+`, and bytes other than `A-Z a-z 0-9 - _ . *` become `%XX`.

```sql
SELECT url_encode('a+b/c'); -- 'a%2Bb%2Fc'
```

Source: [`scalars.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/scalars.rs) (`UrlEncodeUdf`).

<a id="udf-url-decode"></a>

### `url_decode`

**Signature:** `url_decode(text)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, ...)`.

Inverse of `url_encode`; malformed `%` escapes or a non-UTF-8 result return NULL.

```sql
SELECT url_decode('foo+bar'); -- 'foo bar'
```

Source: [`scalars.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/string/scalars.rs) (`UrlDecodeUdf`).

<a id="udf-json-quote"></a>

### `json_quote`

**Signature:** `json_quote(text)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Utf8)`.

Quote text as a JSON string literal, escaping `"`, `\`, control characters, `/` (as `\/`) and non-ASCII characters (as `\uXXXX`).

```sql
SELECT json_quote('value'); -- '"value"'
```

Source: [`constructors.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/constructors.rs) (`json_quote_udf`).

<a id="udf-json-exists"></a>

### `json_exists`

**Signature:** `json_exists(json, path[, on_error])` → `Boolean`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Utf8, ...)`.

True when `path` resolves to a non-null value; a missing path is false. `on_error` is a string literal applied to invalid JSON: `FALSE` (default), `TRUE`, `UNKNOWN` (NULL) or `ERROR`. Paths support `$`, `.key`, `[n]` and `['key']` steps only (no wildcards, recursive descent or filters); an invalid path is an error.

```sql
SELECT json_exists('{"a":1}', '$.a'); -- true
```

Source: [`queries.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/queries.rs) (`JsonExistsUdf`).

<a id="udf-json-array"></a>

### `json_array`

**Signature:** `json_array([value, ...])` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `() or (Any, ...)`.

JSON array of the arguments; NULL becomes `null`. Strings that hold a JSON object or array are embedded as JSON, other strings are quoted; lists, structs and maps are nested.

```sql
SELECT json_array(token_id, amount) FROM transfers;
```

Source: [`constructors.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/constructors.rs) (`JsonArrayUdf`).

<a id="udf-json-array-absent-on-null"></a>

### `json_array_absent_on_null`

**Signature:** `json_array_absent_on_null([value, ...])` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `() or (Any, ...)`.

Same as `json_array`, but NULL arguments are omitted.

```sql
SELECT json_array_absent_on_null(token_id, memo) FROM transfers;
```

Source: [`constructors.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/constructors.rs) (`JsonArrayUdf`).

<a id="udf-json-object"></a>

### `json_object`

**Signature:** `json_object([key, value, ...])` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `() or (Any, ...)`.

JSON object from key/value pairs; requires an even number of arguments. NULL values become `null`; a NULL key is an error. Values are converted as in `json_array`.

```sql
SELECT json_object('address', from_address, 'amount', amount) FROM transfers;
```

Source: [`constructors.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/constructors.rs) (`JsonObjectUdf`).

<a id="udf-json-object-absent-on-null"></a>

### `json_object_absent_on_null`

**Signature:** `json_object_absent_on_null([key, value, ...])` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `() or (Any, ...)`.

Same as `json_object`, but pairs with a NULL value are omitted.

```sql
SELECT json_object_absent_on_null('address', from_address, 'memo', memo) FROM transfers;
```

Source: [`constructors.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/constructors.rs) (`JsonObjectUdf`).

<a id="udf-json"></a>

### `json`

**Signature:** `json(text)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(String)`.

Validate JSON text and re-serialize it compactly; empty or whitespace-only text returns NULL and invalid JSON is an error.

```sql
SELECT json('{"a": 1}');
```

Source: [`constructors.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/constructors.rs) (`JsonLiteralUdf`).

<a id="udf-json-unquote"></a>

### `json_unquote`

**Signature:** `json_unquote(text)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(String)`.

Unescape a double-quoted JSON string; other text is returned unchanged.

```sql
SELECT json_unquote('"value"');
```

Source: [`constructors.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/constructors.rs) (`JsonUnquoteUdf`).

<a id="udf-json-query"></a>

### `json_query`

**Signature:** `json_query(json, path[, returning, wrapper, on_empty, on_error])` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Utf8, Utf8) or (Utf8, Utf8, Utf8, Utf8, Utf8, Utf8)`.

JSON text of the object or array at `path`. A scalar at `path` counts as empty and returns NULL unless wrapped; use `json_value` for scalars. The 6-argument form takes string literals: `returning` is `STRING` or `ARRAY`; `wrapper` is `WITHOUT ARRAY` (default), `WITH CONDITIONAL ARRAY` or `WITH UNCONDITIONAL ARRAY`; `on_empty` and `on_error` are `NULL` (default), `EMPTY ARRAY`, `EMPTY OBJECT` or `ERROR`. Paths support `$`, `.key`, `[n]` and `['key']` steps only (no wildcards, recursive descent or filters); an invalid path is an error.

```sql
SELECT json_query('{"a":{"b":[1,2]}}', '$.a'); -- '{"b":[1,2]}'
```

Source: [`queries.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/queries.rs) (`JsonQueryUdf`).

<a id="udf-json-value"></a>

### `json_value`

**Signature:** `json_value(json, path[, returning, on_empty, empty_default, on_error, error_default])` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, ...)`.

Scalar at `path` as text (strings are unquoted). An object, array, JSON `null` or missing path counts as empty and returns NULL by default; invalid JSON returns NULL by default. The 7-argument form takes string literals: `returning` is `STRING`, `VARCHAR` or `CHAR`; `on_empty` and `on_error` are `NULL`, `ERROR` or `DEFAULT`, where `DEFAULT` returns the following argument. Paths support `$`, `.key`, `[n]` and `['key']` steps only (no wildcards, recursive descent or filters); an invalid path is an error.

```sql
SELECT json_value('{"a":null}', '$.a', 'STRING', 'DEFAULT', 'missing', 'NULL', NULL); -- 'missing'
```

Source: [`queries.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/queries.rs) (`JsonValueUdf`).

<a id="udf-parse-json"></a>

### `parse_json`

**Signature:** `parse_json(text[, allow_duplicate_keys])` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Utf8) or (Utf8, Boolean)`.

Validate JSON text and re-serialize it compactly; invalid JSON is an error and empty text returns NULL. `allow_duplicate_keys` must be a Boolean literal and is currently ignored.

```sql
SELECT parse_json(metadata) FROM tokens;
```

Source: [`parsing.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/parsing.rs) (`ParseJsonUdf`).

<a id="udf-try-parse-json"></a>

### `try_parse_json`

**Signature:** `try_parse_json(text[, allow_duplicate_keys])` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Utf8) or (Utf8, Boolean)`.

Same as `parse_json`, but invalid JSON returns NULL.

```sql
SELECT try_parse_json(metadata) FROM tokens;
```

Source: [`parsing.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/parsing.rs) (`ParseJsonUdf`).

<a id="udf-is-json"></a>

### `is_json`

**Signature:** `is_json(text[, type])` → `Boolean`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Utf8) or (Utf8, Utf8)`.

Whether text parses as JSON of `type`, a string literal: `VALUE` (default), `OBJECT`, `ARRAY` or `SCALAR`. NULL input returns false.

```sql
SELECT is_json(metadata, 'OBJECT') FROM tokens;
```

Source: [`parsing.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/parsing.rs) (`IsJsonUdf`).

## Flink-compatible JSON aggregates

Aggregate functions registered by `register_json_functions`.

| Function | Signature | Accepted types | Returns |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`json_arrayagg_null_on_null`](#udf-json-arrayagg-null-on-null) | `json_arrayagg_null_on_null(value)` | `(Any)` | `Utf8` |
| [`json_arrayagg_absent_on_null`](#udf-json-arrayagg-absent-on-null) | `json_arrayagg_absent_on_null(value)` | `(Any)` | `Utf8` |
| [`json_objectagg_null_on_null`](#udf-json-objectagg-null-on-null) | `json_objectagg_null_on_null(key, value)` | `(Any, Any)` | `Utf8` |
| [`json_objectagg_absent_on_null`](#udf-json-objectagg-absent-on-null) | `json_objectagg_absent_on_null(key, value)` | `(Any, Any)` | `Utf8` |

<a id="udf-json-arrayagg-null-on-null"></a>

### `json_arrayagg_null_on_null`

**Signature:** `json_arrayagg_null_on_null(value)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any)`.

Aggregate: JSON array of the group's values, with NULL as `null`; values are converted as in `json_array`. An empty group returns NULL. `DISTINCT`, `ORDER BY` and `IGNORE NULLS` are rejected.

```sql
SELECT owner, json_arrayagg_null_on_null(token_id) FROM transfers GROUP BY owner;
```

Source: [`aggregates.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/aggregates.rs) (`JsonArrayAggUdf`).

<a id="udf-json-arrayagg-absent-on-null"></a>

### `json_arrayagg_absent_on_null`

**Signature:** `json_arrayagg_absent_on_null(value)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any)`.

Same as `json_arrayagg_null_on_null`, but NULL values are omitted.

```sql
SELECT owner, json_arrayagg_absent_on_null(token_id) FROM transfers GROUP BY owner;
```

Source: [`aggregates.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/aggregates.rs) (`JsonArrayAggUdf`).

<a id="udf-json-objectagg-null-on-null"></a>

### `json_objectagg_null_on_null`

**Signature:** `json_objectagg_null_on_null(key, value)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, Any)`.

Aggregate: JSON object of the group's key/value pairs, with NULL values as `null`. A NULL or duplicate key is an error; an empty group returns NULL. `DISTINCT`, `ORDER BY` and `IGNORE NULLS` are rejected.

```sql
SELECT owner, json_objectagg_null_on_null(token_id, amount) FROM transfers GROUP BY owner;
```

Source: [`aggregates.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/aggregates.rs) (`JsonObjectAggUdf`).

<a id="udf-json-objectagg-absent-on-null"></a>

### `json_objectagg_absent_on_null`

**Signature:** `json_objectagg_absent_on_null(key, value)` → `Utf8`. **DataFusion signature:** `(Any, Any)`.

Same as `json_objectagg_null_on_null`, but pairs with a NULL value are omitted.

```sql
SELECT owner, json_objectagg_absent_on_null(token_id, amount) FROM transfers GROUP BY owner;
```

Source: [`aggregates.rs`](../crates/streamling-flink-compat/src/json/aggregates.rs) (`JsonObjectAggUdf`).

## Flink-compatible aliases of DataFusion built-ins

`register_string_aliases` re-registers these DataFusion built-ins under extra names; behavior is the built-in's.

| Built-in | Extra names |
| --- | --- |
| `starts_with` | `startswith` |
| `ends_with` | `endswith` |
| `lower` | `lowercase` |
| `upper` | `uppercase` |
| `regexp_like` | `regexp`, `similar` |
| `character_length` | `charlength` |
| `to_hex` | `hex` |
